name: Healthy Babies
overview: Scripture teaches that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, a divine reward from the fruit of the womb, highlighting God's sovereign role in their creation and care. From the moment of formation in the womb, God intimately knows and sanctifies each child, as seen in His foreknowledge and purpose for Jeremiah before birth. Furthermore, the responsibility of training a child in the way they should go underscores the importance of godly guidance to ensure they remain faithful throughout life.
